summary: The launcher is remade from zero as the ZLauncher replacement. The core loop is Concord-first browsing with launch actions: a zellij tab on the work's Concord worktree, the OpenCode session started through Concord's session bootstrap, resume, and prompt pass-through as the work directive. The interface is dense panes on arrow, Enter, and Tab keys, still rendered by Bubble Tea v2. The launcher stays store-write-free. ZLauncher is retired when the core loop and the accepted daily extras work on the real store.
title: the launcher is the ZLauncher replacement
